scoring_justification: Full recompute of the underlying DFT/Berry-phase simulation from raw outputs is infeasible; the checker verifies that the agent's computed final scalars match the paper's reported values within tolerances, providing a consistency check with the original study.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for Mössbauer parameters (isomer shift change, quadrupolar splitting, screening factor) as reported in the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Bashkirov & Lebedev, phys. stat. sol. (b) 92, 397 (1979); explicit numbers in text (isomer shift change +0.103 mm/s, total QS -0.484 mm/s, 4s contribution -0.288 mm/s, R_4p=0.51, E_para=8e8 V/cm, rho_4s=0.2).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly quoted from paper's equations and numerical results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are taken from the original paper and are the target of the reproduction.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected temperature-dependent quadrupolar splitting values computed from the paper's model using spontaneous polarization data from Merz (1953) and the formulas described in the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the paper's equations (10) and the scaling assumptions (Fe displacement and local field proportional to P_s), with P_s values from Merz, Phys. Rev. 91, 513 (1953) as used in the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Computed using the paper's analytical expressions: total QS(T) = curve1(20°C)*(P_s(T)/P_s(20°C)) + ΔW_Q(E(20°C))*b²(E(T))/b²(E(20°C)), with b²(E) from two-level mixing model, constants as in paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The model and parameters are fully described in the paper; the computed reference values are deterministic and serve as a consistency check.

outputs.description: Scored values: isomer shift discontinuous change at Tc, quadrupolar splitting decomposition, and deduced 4p screening factor.
Temperature dependence of quadrupolar splitting. Compare each row's QS to reference values and verify monotonic trend.

output_contract.notes: All computed Mössbauer parameters are deterministic given the public inputs and the described procedures. The hidden checker compares the reported values to paper-derived gold values with appropriate tolerances.
